fluff.overview: The Capellan Confederation has always relied on its infantry to compensate for the CCAF's chronic shortage of heavier assets. Conventional foot soldiers, drawn from the citizens' militia system that defines Capellan military service, form the backbone of garrison forces across the Confederation's commonalities. Motorized platoons provide the CCAF with faster-moving infantry that can reposition between garrison posts or screen advancing forces along road networks. Their motorcycle and light vehicle transports sacrifice protection for speed, making them best suited to patrol and rapid-response roles. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these platoons field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
